title: ゴミ出し・家の当番
subject_en: Hand-drawn loose-line illustrations of everyday household chores, each ONE person or scene centred in its cell, relaxed warm colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ゴミ出し、分別、せんたく、そうじなど、家の当番の場面12点。町内のおしらせや家族の当番表に。
items: a person carrying a garbage bag to a collection point
a person sorting trash into three bins
a bundle of newspapers tied with string and flattened boxes
a crate of bottles and cans
a person hanging laundry on a line
a person vacuuming a living room
a person with a shopping bag and a reusable bag
a person cooking at the stove
a child helping to set the table
two neighbours greeting each other in front of houses
